headlines.title: Inside China’s flood devastation
headlines.description: The Chinese government allowed international journalists for the first time to see the flood devastation inside Tibet. NBC News’ Janis Mackey Frayer reports.

headlines.title: Cargo plane slams into vehicles killing 5 in Miami
headlines.description: The NTSB is investigating how an Amazon Prime branded cargo plane overran a runway and slammed into multiple vehicles. NBC News’ George Solis reports from Miami International Airport.

headlines.title: Man arrested after lunging at Ohio candidate for governor
headlines.description: A man was arrested after lunging at Ohio’s Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton. Witnesses say he pushed his way through a crowd holding a cell phone. Her security detail prevented him from reaching her. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa reports.

headlines.title: Get a First Look at Elizabeth Holmes Doc ‘You Can See Everything’
headlines.description: A trailer is out for “You Can See Everything,” a documentary directed by Nathan Fielder that focuses on Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes leading up to her imprisonment after she was convicted of fraud. Get a first look!

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy Case Ends in Mistrial: Will She Be Tried Again?
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s future remains uncertain after a mistrial was declared Friday in her triple murder case. Now the district attorney is left to contemplate a retrial. NBC’s Valerie Castro reports and legal analyst Danny Cevallos joins TODAY with insight into what may come next.

headlines.title: King Charles says Harry and Meghan will not return as working royals
headlines.description: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex will still not be able to use the titles of His and Her Royal Highness and will remain private citizens, according to a letter sent on behalf of King Charles. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: I found 177+ Labor Day sales that are actually worth shopping — deals up to 75% off end tonight
headlines.description: Labor Day sales are officially in their final hours. Shop deals worth buying from Amazon, Target, REI and more before they’re gone, with discounts up to 75% off.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Trump calls for a Bombardier plane ban, drawing pushback from a GOP senator
headlines.description: President Donald Trump asserted Monday that the Canadian aerospace company Bombardier should no longer be allowed to sell its planes in the U.S., opening a new front in his trade war with Canada.

headlines.title: Iran increases gasoline price for its heaviest consumers as economy struggles
headlines.description: TEHRAN, Iran — Iran early Tuesday introduced a higher price for its heaviest users of gasoline, state media reported, in the latest economic pinch caused by months of war.

headlines.title: Victims of Miami plane crash were in a cleaning-company van and an SUV, officials said
headlines.description: The five people killed when an Amazon-branded cargo airplane overran a runway in Miami had been inside a van transporting a cleaning crew and in a passenger vehicle, the NTSB said.

headlines.title: Ohio Democrat Amy Acton reflects on a ‘rough day’ as witnesses recall ‘frightening’ confrontation
headlines.description: Democrat Amy Acton vowed to continue on as a “fierce warrior” in her campaign for Ohio governor Monday, a day after law enforcement officials said an armed man aggressively attempted to confront her at a county fair.
